scope: Full workspace dependency audit including production and development dependencies; lockfile and installed tree at intake. No packages or persistent npm configuration changed.
captureMethod: PowerShell captured npm stdout to dependency-audit.json as UTF-8 and stderr to dependency-audit.stderr.txt; shell explicitly returned the captured npm exit status. artifactModifiedAtUtc is the file capture completion timestamp, not the command start time.
limitations: Package counts are not unique advisory counts.
Dependency classification does not establish deployed exposure or exploitation.
No application-security or compliance verification performed.
